symptom: Controlled multimap boundary opening retrain used 229 opening edge_recovery repair samples and avoided the previous action 3/action 7 framing, but the 60 second high-pressure comparison failed the soda-creek action-distribution gate and selected action 6 on 5703/7382 soda-creek frames. The same action 6 bias also dominated caramel-workshop and cracked-star-jar.
root_cause: The wider boundary repair input fixed sample coverage but the training recipe still overcorrected online behavior. The combination of inverse-frequency class weighting, entropy regularization 0.01, and edge_recovery_sample_weight 2.0 produced a new deterministic opening bias toward action 6 even though the offline training action distribution was not action 6 dominant.
fix: Do not promote this checkpoint. Run controlled ablations before any long-window evaluation: remove or reduce inverse_frequency class weighting, compare edge_recovery_sample_weight 1.0/1.5/2.0, and keep the deterministic 60 second high-pressure three-map gate as the minimum acceptance screen.
validation: Training, packaging, and deterministic 60 second high-pressure comparison are recorded in harness/reports/2026-05-27_rl_route_recovery_aux_multimap_boundary_opening_001. The comparison gate_decision is multimap_comparison_recorded_needs_policy_repair; soda-creek win_rate is 0.4, average_survival is 49.2129 seconds, damage_taken_average is 106.7094, normalized_action_entropy is 0.3962, and action 6 ratio is 0.7726.
